v0.1.note: the shipped five-curve baseline. Its curves are carried into v0.2 unchanged; only the mask set and the added curves are new.

v0.2.note: v0.1 plus every curve that cleared gates 1 to 3. The builder emits a mask column per curve alongside the curve, so the mask set follows the curve list and is not enumerated separately here. The ablation separates the curves from the masks.

v0.3.note: v0.2 plus same-well local context. Every local column is computed inside one well only, uses no target and no other well, and is invalidated across a logging gap rather than averaged over it. The builder owns the column names.

gates.G1_role: only source columns whose role is log_curve are candidates. DEPTH_MD, the coordinates, GROUP, FORMATION, the target and the target confidence column are excluded by role.
gates.G2_measurement_kind: a candidate must measure the formation. Operational and mud-system curves, and hole-geometry curves, are rejected unless they are already in the frozen v0.1 set.
gates.G3_evaluation_coverage: a candidate must be present in at least 50% of the wells of both evaluation partitions, each of which has 10 wells.
gates.caveat_threshold: a selected curve missing more than 40% of an evaluation partition is flagged, and the flag is carried into the report.

local_context.reason: DEPTH_MD advances by a constant 0.1520 m inside every well in every split (interquartile range 0.0 m, strictly increasing: True), so a fixed row window is a fixed depth window. 128 of 1170413 steps exceed 0.4560 m and are logging gaps, so windows are invalidated across them rather than averaged over them.
